title: Ethics and Technical Aspects of Generative AI Models in Digital Content Creation

bias_targets.methodology: Manual analysis of generated text and images, examining sentiment, tone, and professional vs. domestic role assignments in text (e.g., caregivers vs. authoritative roles), as well as stereotypical visual cues in images.
Manual analysis of generated text and image outputs for stereotypical or prejudiced visual cues, particularly when prompts involve ethnicity.
Manual evaluation of text and image outputs for the reinforcement of cultural stereotypes and the representation of cultural symbols.
Included in the ethical assessment framework, evaluated via manual analysis of sentiment and tone in text and visual cues in images to identify hidden societal biases.
